summary: The guide page strictly complies with its assigned scope, chapter plan, and boundaries. All cited primary sources (ISO/IAF APG Documenting, ISO/IAF APG Review and Closing, and NIST RPD-G-07) are cited accurately with explicit contextual disclaimers noting auditor guidance and laboratory service limits. All four subsections incorporate assigned workflow decisions, roles, records, exceptions, and software evaluation criteria. Examples are consistently labeled as hypothetical illustrative scenarios featuring an unnamed manufacturer. No unassigned FAQ section was included.

glossary.definition: Immediate steps that limit the effect of a finding while its cause is investigated.
Action to eliminate a detected nonconformity (ISO 9000 as quoted in the ISO/IAF APG paper).
Action to eliminate the cause of a nonconformity and prevent recurrence.
Non-fulfillment of a requirement (ISO 9000 as cited in the APG paper).
The role responsible for decisions and records in the defined workflow.

decisions: Confirm or reject a finding as a true nonconformity
Assign significance rating and workflow routing
Define containment boundary and scope (lots, serial numbers, machines, shifts)
Select and authorize immediate containment action (hold, stop, sort, recall)
Notify internal roles, customers, or suppliers
Approve release of held product or work resumption
Authorize documented override for incomplete containment evidence
